historical_references.reference: Divaani was a legendary heroine in ancient Indian texts, particularly in the Puranas. She was the wife of King Yudhishthira and was known for her exceptional virtues, including devotion to her husband and her renunciation of material possessions. She is also referred to as Draupadi, the wife of the Pandava brothers.

Divaani was also the name of a queen in medieval India, particularly in the kingdom of Malwa. She is known for her role in the Battle of Kirata, where she led an army of women against the invading army of the king of Kalinga. Her bravery and leadership were instrumental in the victory of the Malwans.
